subject: Auditing and Ethics
question_text:
14.  In case any intangible asset is not in active use by the entity, the auditor
should check whether: -
(A)  The deletion with respect to the intangible asset has been recorded in
the books of accounts post-approval by the entity's management.
(B)  The amortization charge has ceased beyond the date of deletion.
(C)  The deletion with respect to the intangible asset has been recorded in
the books of accounts post-approval by the entity's management and
the amortization charge shall be continued.
(D)  The deletion with respect to the intangible asset has been recorded in
the books of accounts post-approval by the entity's management and
the amortisation charge has ceased beyond the date of deletion.

(2 Marks)
